what: studio-more30 deployed to production so the projects screen (#129) reaches the browser; verified anonymously against more30.com, not against the vercel.app host (NetFree blocks it).

deployment.base: /studio/ (vite base override; the repo config ships /modaot/)

index_html_byte_check.difference: 236 bytes, three lines, all of them NetFree's local proxy injection (go-payment.js, popup-card-init.js). Nothing the origin sent differs.

screen_live.note: the router is useHashLocation (client/src/App.tsx:2), so /studio/projects is not the address of the screen — it serves the SPA shell and lands on Home. The address is /studio#/projects.

finding.summary: the screen shipped and it cannot load work: every /api call in the client is root-relative, so under the /studio mount it goes to more30.com/api/... and the portal answers 404.
measured: GET https://more30.com/api/projects -> 404 (console, from the projects screen)
GET https://more30.com/studio/api/projects -> 200 []  (the same route under the mount)
finding.scope: all 26 registered routes, not just the five project ones — which is why public.studio_projects holds 0 rows: the save never reached the server either.

qa: scripts/qa/studio-client-calls-server.mjs 11/11 — the deployed bundle and the source now call the same routes, drift empty.
